description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grant [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Thief Mode I (Vaan)] and [Thief Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Thief Mode I (Vaan)
description.text: Thief abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Thief abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Thief abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Thief Mode II (Vaan)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Thief Mode II (Vaan)
description.text: Thief abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Thief abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00 for Thief abilities, grants [100% Critical 2], [Damage Cap +10000 2] and [Buff Wind 20% (5s)] to the user after using Thief abilities

description.name: Buff Wind 20% (5s)
description.text: Increases Wind damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3
